dialogues.jp:
なんとなく、どんどんと姿を消していくクラス
メートを眺めながら考える。
dialogues.en: I was thinking as I saw my classmates leaving the school.
dialogues.text: I was thinking as I saw my classmates leaving the school.

dialogues.jp: やはり、家には帰りたくないな。
dialogues.en: I don't really want to go home.
dialogues.text: I don't really want to go home.

dialogues.jp:
帰ればたぶん……いや、間違いなく、さくらに
襲撃されるだろう。
dialogues.en:
If I go home, I'll probably...... no, definitely be attacked
by Sakura.
dialogues.text:
If I go home, I'll probably...... no, definitely be attacked
by Sakura.

dialogues.jp:
まぁ、帰りを遅くしたところで、どのみち会う
ことにはなるのだろうが、人には誰しも現実逃
避したくなる時がある。
dialogues.en:
Even if I go home later I'll see her anyway, but I just want
to escape from that reality for a while.
dialogues.text:
Even if I go home later I'll see her anyway, but I just want
to escape from that reality for a while.

dialogues.jp: 「学園をぶらついて、時間をつぶすか」
dialogues.en:
"I'm just going to walk around the school and kill some
time."
dialogues.text:
"I'm just going to walk around the school and kill some
time."

dialogues.jp: そのまま帰れるよう、鞄を持って廊下に出る。
dialogues.en: I held my bag and went out to the hallway.
dialogues.text: I held my bag and went out to the hallway.

dialogues.jp:
探検家になったつもりで、辺りをのんびり眺め
ながら歩く。
dialogues.en:
I walked slowly, observing the surroundings as if I was an
explorer.
dialogues.text:
I walked slowly, observing the surroundings as if I was an
explorer.

dialogues.jp:
それなりに掃除の行き届いた、しかし隅々は汚
れている廊下。
dialogues.en: The hallways were clean enough, but some parts were dirty.
dialogues.text: The hallways were clean enough, but some parts were dirty.

dialogues.jp:
何故か、異様に｛・・・・／テカテカ｝と光る段を避け、階段
を下りる。
dialogues.en: I went down the stairs, skipping a few steps.
dialogues.text: I went down the stairs, skipping a few steps.

dialogues.jp:
１階の教室では、女子が掃除をするなか、男子
がホウキを振り回し野球を楽しんでいる。
dialogues.en:
In one of the classrooms on the first floor, I see some boys
playing baseball using a broom as a bat, while some girls
are sweeping the floor.
dialogues.text:
In one of the classrooms on the first floor, I see some boys
playing baseball using a broom as a bat, while some girls
are sweeping the floor.

dialogues.jp: 本校に行くため、間にある特別教室棟を抜ける。
dialogues.en:
I walked through the middle building in order to get to the
main campus.
dialogues.text:
I walked through the middle building in order to get to the
main campus.

dialogues.jp:
途中、杉並を愛してやまない生活指導の講師に、
デートに誘われるが、偽情報を流してやり過ご
した。
dialogues.en:
On my way, one teacher came up to me to try to get some
inside information about Suginami's bad behavior, but I
managed to escape by giving out false information.
dialogues.text:
On my way, one teacher came up to me to try to get some
inside information about Suginami's bad behavior, but I
managed to escape by giving out false information.

dialogues.jp: 「俺のタイプじゃないからな」
dialogues.en: "I don't want to be a snitch."
dialogues.text: "I don't want to be a snitch."

dialogues.jp: 「うむ……視線を感じる」
dialogues.en: "Hmm...... I feel someone staring at me."
dialogues.text: "Hmm...... I feel someone staring at me."

dialogues.jp:
なんとなく踏み入ってしまった本校校舎だが、
付属の制服を着ていると嫌でも目立つ。
dialogues.en: My school uniform makes me stand out on the main campus.
dialogues.text: My school uniform makes me stand out on the main campus.

dialogues.jp:
ここには、ホウキを振り回している輩はいない。
｛・・／僅か｝の女子が、掃除に励んでいた。
dialogues.en:
I don't see anyone playing with a broom in this building. A
few girls are working hard to clean the school.
dialogues.text:
I don't see anyone playing with a broom in this building. A
few girls are working hard to clean the school.

dialogues.jp: 造りは同じでも、向こうとは雰囲気が違う。
dialogues.en:
This was supposed to be the same building, but the
atmosphere felt different here.
dialogues.text:
This was supposed to be the same building, but the
atmosphere felt different here.

dialogues.jp:
（まあ、あと二ヶ月もしないうちに、こっちの
　校舎に通うことになるんだけど……）
dialogues.en: ----Bump.
dialogues.text: ----Bump.

dialogues.jp:
その下見と思えば、この散歩も有意義なものと
言える。
dialogues.en: Suddenly, I felt a light pressure on my back.
dialogues.text: Suddenly, I felt a light pressure on my back.

dialogues.jp:
と、なかば強引に自分を納得させたところで、
後ろを振り返る。
dialogues.en:
When I turned my neck and looked back, I saw a girl with a
ponytail. She was wearing a white bow that stood up.
dialogues.text:
When I turned my neck and looked back, I saw a girl with a
ponytail. She was wearing a white bow that stood up.

dialogues.jp: 「で、いつまでついてくるんだ？　美春」
dialogues.en:
It feels like this girl's pressing her body against my
back......
dialogues.text:
It feels like this girl's pressing her body against my
back......

dialogues.jp:
忍者のように壁に張り付こうとしていた美春が
苦笑いを浮かべる。
dialogues.en: For some reason, she kept on pushing me.
dialogues.text: For some reason, she kept on pushing me.

dialogues.jp:
俺と同じく、美春の制服も付属のものだ。本校
の校舎で目立たないわけがない。
dialogues.en: "......Does she want to move forward or something?"
dialogues.text: "......Does she want to move forward or something?"

dialogues.jp:
気づいていないのは、俺を追うのに一生懸命で
周囲に目が配れなかった美春本人ぐらいのもの
だろう。
dialogues.en: Even a robot could do a better job avoiding obstacles.
dialogues.text: Even a robot could do a better job avoiding obstacles.

dialogues.jp:
「俺の後を尾けさせたのは誰の差し金なんだ？
　風紀委員か、それとも音夢の指示なのか？」
dialogues.en: When I moved my body and tried to let her go past......
dialogues.text: When I moved my body and tried to let her go past......

dialogues.jp: えへへへと美春が舌を出す。
dialogues.en: ----Thud!
dialogues.text: ----Thud!

dialogues.jp: 「ほう」
dialogues.en:
She fell onto the floor without guarding herself with her
hands.
dialogues.text:
She fell onto the floor without guarding herself with her
hands.

dialogues.jp: ｛ひつけとうぞくあらためかた／火付盗賊改方｝の密偵より目ざといじゃないか。

つーか、俺ってほとんど犯罪者扱いだな。風紀
委員のブラックリストに顔写真付きで載ってる
んじゃないかとすら思えてくる。
「ただ散歩をしていただけなんだが……」
dialogues.en: "Are you all right?"
dialogues.text: "Are you all right?"

dialogues.jp: こいつ、本気で俺が何かしでかすと思ってたな。
dialogues.en:
She slammed her face on the floor without a single scream. I
was worried, and I shook her body.
dialogues.text:
She slammed her face on the floor without a single scream. I
was worried, and I shook her body.

dialogues.jp:
「何か期待していたんなら、ご期待に応えてやっ
　てもいいんだが……」
慌てて、美春がぷるぷると首を横に振る。

美春が懇願するように、両手を胸の前で組み合
わせる。
dialogues.en: "It's her......"
dialogues.text: "It's her......"

dialogues.jp: （さて、どうしようかな）
dialogues.en:
The girl woke up with a big stretch and a yawn. It was
Moe-sempai......
dialogues.text:
The girl woke up with a big stretch and a yawn. It was
Moe-sempai......

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「ふぁ……はぁぁ……」
dialogues.en: "Hello, Asakura-kun."
dialogues.text: "Hello, Asakura-kun."

dialogues.jp:
大きな｛あくび／欠伸｝をしながら、倒れていた女の子……
萌先輩が起き上がる。

ドキリとするような素直な笑みに、顔についた
埃までもが可愛く見える。
dialogues.en: Her pure smile made even the dust on her face look cute.
dialogues.text: Her pure smile made even the dust on her face look cute.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「どうも、ありがとうございました」
dialogues.en: "Thank you very much."
dialogues.text: "Thank you very much."

dialogues.jp: 深々と、萌先輩が頭を下げる。
dialogues.en: Moe-sempai politely bowed at me.
dialogues.text: Moe-sempai politely bowed at me.

dialogues.en: "Huh?"
dialogues.text: "Huh?"

dialogues.jp: なんのことか分からず、呆けた返事を返す。
dialogues.en: I asked her, not knowing what she was thanking me for.
dialogues.text: I asked her, not knowing what she was thanking me for.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「こんな所で寝ていたら、風邪を引いてしまう
　ところでした」
dialogues.en: "I was going to catch a cold, sleeping here."
dialogues.text: "I was going to catch a cold, sleeping here."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「それに、皆さんの通行の邪魔になってしまい
　ましたね」
dialogues.en: "Also, I was going to be in everyone's way."
dialogues.text: "Also, I was going to be in everyone's way."

dialogues.jp: そう言って、周囲にぺこぺこと頭を下げた。
dialogues.en: She also bowed at everyone else around us.
dialogues.text: She also bowed at everyone else around us.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「どうも」
dialogues.en:
"But it's strange...... Why did I fall asleep in a place
like this?"
dialogues.text:
"But it's strange...... Why did I fall asleep in a place
like this?"

dialogues.jp: 美春も何となく会釈を返す。
dialogues.en: Moe-sempai tilted her headwith a wondering expression.
dialogues.text: Moe-sempai tilted her headwith a wondering expression.

dialogues.jp: 萌先輩は不思議そうに小首を傾げる。
dialogues.en: "......Umm, is your face okay?"
dialogues.text: "......Umm, is your face okay?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「えっ？」
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「そう言えば……なんとなく、ヒリヒリします」
dialogues.en: "It does...... kind of hurt."
dialogues.text: "It does...... kind of hurt."

dialogues.jp:
今まで気づかなかったのか、今更ながらに、頬
を｛さす／擦｝っている。
dialogues.en:
She finally realized that she was in pain, and she rubbed
her cheek.
dialogues.text:
She finally realized that she was in pain, and she rubbed
her cheek.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「それに……なんだか、埃もついているみたい
　です」
dialogues.en: "......And I have some dust on my face too."
dialogues.text: "......And I have some dust on my face too."

dialogues.jp:
擦った手を見て、ゆっくりした手つきで、顔に
ついた埃を取り除いている。
dialogues.en:
She looked at her dusty hand and slowly started to wipe her
face.
dialogues.text:
She looked at her dusty hand and slowly started to wipe her
face.

dialogues.jp: 「転んで、顔を打ちつけてたから……」
dialogues.en: "You fell and hit your face on the floor......"
dialogues.text: "You fell and hit your face on the floor......"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「はぁ……そうだったんですか。ダメですね、
　私ったら、ほんとドジで」
dialogues.en: "Oh...... is that true? Shame on me......"
dialogues.text: "Oh...... is that true? Shame on me......"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「やっぱり、眠りながら歩くのって、危険なん
　でしょうか？」
dialogues.en: "I guess it's dangerous to walk sleepwalk, huh?"
dialogues.text: "I guess it's dangerous to walk sleepwalk, huh?"

dialogues.jp: 何故か困った顔をする萌先輩。
dialogues.en: She spoke with a concerned look.
dialogues.text: She spoke with a concerned look.

dialogues.jp: 「……って言うか、よく寝ながら歩けますね」
dialogues.en: "......I mean, how can you walk while you sleep?"
dialogues.text: "......I mean, how can you walk while you sleep?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「ええ、簡単ですから」
dialogues.en: "It's easy."
dialogues.text: "It's easy."

dialogues.jp: 俺と美春が、互いに無言で顔を見合わせる。

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「……あの、何か私、変なことを言いましたで
　しょうか？」
dialogues.en: "......Umm, did I just say something weird?"
dialogues.text: "......Umm, did I just say something weird?"

dialogues.jp: 黙っている俺達に、困惑げな表情を浮かべる。
dialogues.en: As I remained silent, she asked me with a confused face.
dialogues.text: As I remained silent, she asked me with a confused face.

dialogues.jp: 「いや、ちょっと軽い｛めまい／眩暈｝が……」
dialogues.en:
"No, I just felt light headed...... It's amazing how you can
move while sleeping."
dialogues.text:
"No, I just felt light headed...... It's amazing how you can
move while sleeping."

dialogues.jp:
あははは、と美春がぎこちない笑い声で賛同す
る。
dialogues.en: It is indeed mysterious.
dialogues.text: It is indeed mysterious.

dialogues.jp:
「それにしても、萌先輩、よく寝てるのに身体
　が動きますね？」
dialogues.en:
"I don't need to use my brain for something that my body
remembers."
dialogues.text:
"I don't need to use my brain for something that my body
remembers."

dialogues.jp: それが不思議だ。

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「身体が覚えていることに、頭は必要ありませ
　んから」
dialogues.en: "I mean, a body can remember certain movements, right?"
dialogues.text: "I mean, a body can remember certain movements, right?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.en: "Yeah...... I guess......"
dialogues.text: "Yeah...... I guess......"

dialogues.jp:
何か……言葉の意味を逸脱している気がするん
ですけど……。
dialogues.en: I think she's taking that phrase the wrong way......
dialogues.text: I think she's taking that phrase the wrong way......

dialogues.jp: ――っていうか、｛きわ／究｝めてる？
dialogues.en: ...She's really strange.
dialogues.text: ...She's really strange.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「じゃあ、私はこれで失礼しますね」
dialogues.en: "Well, I should go now."
dialogues.text: "Well, I should go now."

dialogues.jp:
そう言って、萌先輩は｛・・・・・／目を瞑って｝、行ってしまっ
た……。
dialogues.en: She spokeand left with her eyes closed again......
dialogues.text: She spokeand left with her eyes closed again......

dialogues.jp: ◆身体が自然に動く◆
dialogues.en: ◆The body remembers the movement◆
dialogues.text: ◆The body remembers the movement◆

dialogues.jp:
廊下を歩いていたら萌先輩に後ろから追突され
たんだけど……よく寝ながら歩けると思う。
dialogues.en:
When I was walking down the hallway, Moe-sempai bumped into
me...... How could she walk while sleeping?
dialogues.text:
When I was walking down the hallway, Moe-sempai bumped into
me...... How could she walk while sleeping?

dialogues.jp:
簡単だと先輩は言っていたけど、そんなはずは
ない。
dialogues.en: She said it was easy to do, but I don't believe it.
dialogues.text: She said it was easy to do, but I don't believe it.

dialogues.jp:
『身体が自然に動く』という萌先輩はやはり万
物を超越しているとしか思えない……。
dialogues.en:
Moe said that the body remembers certain movements, but I
think she's nothing but a strange person......
dialogues.text:
Moe said that the body remembers certain movements, but I
think she's nothing but a strange person......
